The elder (<s>sthavira</s>) said: 'Son, indeed...'
GBM 1508.3 (Divy -) /// ... he delights (in her) and serves (her), until his wife became pregnant. She, after nine complete (months)...
GBM 1508.4 (cf. Divy 351.14) /// ... pleasing. Having performed his birth festival in detail, he was named <s>Aśvagupta</s>. With a wet-nurse...
GBM 1508.5 (cf. Divy 351.14f.) /// ... having grown up, he was given for training in a suitable occupation. Then the elder <s>Śāṇavāsī</s>...
GBM 1508.6 (cf. Divy 351.16f.) /// ... '(a) son will be — him we shall give afterward as a renunciant to the noble one.'

children.translated_text:
'This son of yours has been born...'
GBM 1508.7 (cf. Divy 351.18f.) /// ... (he is) an only son. Another, whoever will be our second son — him we shall give to the noble one afterward as a renunciant...'
GBM 1508.8 (cf. Divy 351.21f.) /// ... he does not see. Then the elder said: 'So be it.' Until his second son was born...
GBM 1509.1 (cf. Divy 351.23f.) /// ... it came to pass. Then the elder <s>Śāṇavāsī</s>, having approached <s>Gupta</s> the perfumer, said: 'You had promised...'
GBM 1509.2 (cf. Divy 351.26f.) /// ... 'I shall give (him).'

children.translated_text:
'And this second son of yours has been born. Allow me — I will ordain (him).' <s>Gupta</s> the perfumer (said)...
GBM 1509.3 (cf. Divy 351.28f.) /// ... '(He is the one) who will look after the household. Rather, whoever will be our third son — he (shall be given) to the noble one...'
GBM 1509.4 (cf. Divy 351.30ff.) /// ... that is <s>Upagupta</s> — does he see or not? He said: 'So be it.' Until <s>Gupta</s>'s third son...
GBM 1509.5 (cf. Divy 352.2f.) /// ... having an umbrella-shaped head, a broad forehead, surpassing human complexion yet not having attained (divine form)...
GBM 1509.6 (cf. Divy -) /// ... nourished with milk, yogurt, butter, honey, and such. And from the very day he was born, thenceforth...
GBM 1509.7 (cf. Divy 352.3f.) /// ... and with grain-seeds and such, (the business) began to increase. His birth festival in detail...
GBM 1509.8 (cf. Divy 352.5) /// ... he was placed in (the study of) calculation and accounting, and before long became accomplished. Then the perfumer...
GBM 1510.1 (cf. Divy 352.5f.) /// ... obtains. Until the elder <s>Śāṇavāsī</s>, having approached <s>Gupta</s>, said:
GBM 1510.2 (cf. Divy 352.7f.) /// ... 'I shall give (him) to the noble one.'

[GBM 1510.5] (Divyāvadāna —) /// [lacuna] ... 'He has gone forth (<s>pravrajita</s>); now he will empty (<s>śūnyīkariṣyati</s>) the entire domain. What now is the timely [matter] here?' [lacuna]
[GBM 1510.6] (cf. Divyāvadāna 352.10) /// [lacuna] ... 'He will go forth even before [the time].' Then, by <s>Māra</s>, in order to complete the appointed time (<s>samayaparipūraṇārtha</s>), [lacuna covering] all ...
[GBM 1510.7] (cf. Divyāvadāna 352.12) /// [lacuna] ... and they take goods (<s>dravyāṇi</s>); on that account they obtain great gain (<s>bahulābha</s>), until the Elder <s>Śāṇavāsin</s> ...
[GBM 1510.8] (cf. Divyāvadāna 352.14f.) /// [lacuna] ... he remains and also sells perfumes (<s>gandhāṃś ca vikṛṇāti</s>). Then the Elder <s>Śāṇakavāsin</s> addressed [him]: 'Son (<s>vatsa</s>), what ...' [lacuna]

[GBM 1511.2] (cf. Divyāvadāna —) /// [lacuna] ... '<s>Dharmas</s> arise; those that arise together with an afflicted mind are the afflicted ones.' [lacuna]
[GBM 1511.3] (cf. Divyāvadāna 352.15f.) /// [lacuna] ... [the Elder] <s>Gahyo</s> [or <s>Guhya</s>] spoke: 'Son (<s>vatsa</s>), what kind of mental and mental-factor <s>dharmas</s> (<s>cittacaitasikā dharmāḥ</s>) arise for you? Are they afflicted (<s>kliṣṭa</s>) or not [lacuna]'
[GBM 1511.4] (cf. Divyāvadāna 352.17ff.) /// [lacuna] ... 'Son (<s>vatsa</s>), if you are able to comprehend the mind (<s>citta</s>) [and] to resort to the antidote (<s>pratipakṣa</s>), then by that [method], its dark [side] ...' [lacuna]

children.translated_text: Her servant girl used to buy perfumes day after day from <s>Upagupta</s>'s [shop]. [GBM 1512.2] /// ... 'O girl, the perfume-seller is being cheated by you—you bring too many perfumes.' The girl said, 'Yes, [GBM 1512.3] /// ... and he acts according to the <s>dharma</s> ...' And having heard this, <s>Vāsavadattā</s> [sent a message] to <s>Upagupta</s>'s [GBM 1512.4] /// ... presence: 'I shall come to you; I desire to experience pleasure together with you.' [GBM 1512.5] /// ... <s>Vāsavadattā</s> charges five hundred <s>purāṇas</s> (ancient coins) for her services. Then this thought arose in her: [GBM 1512.6] /// ... The messenger was dismissed: 'Noble son, I have no need of anything from you.' [GBM 1512.7] /// ... 'It is not the time, sister, for you to see me.' Meanwhile, a certain merchant's son, <s>Vāsa</s>- [GBM 1512.8] /// ... [from] the northern trade route, having acquired five hundred [coins worth of] horse merchandise, arrived at <s>Mathurā</s>. He said, 'Where [GBM 1513.1] /// ... ?' He went to <s>Vāsavadattā</s>'s presence with many gifts. Then <s>Vāsavadattā</s> conceived this [thought]: [GBM 1513.2] /// ... [money] was taken from [<s>Upagupta</s>], and this horse-merchant [offers] five hundred <s>purāṇas</s> and abundant northern trade-route gifts. [GBM 1513.3] /// ... Having gone [to him], she will experience pleasure with him—from this much profit, there will be loss. How now shall [she] act? [GBM 1513.4] /// ... Having made him drink poisoned liquor, [the horse-merchant] was killed. Then, having been thrown into a refuse heap, the horse-merchant's entry [was concealed]. [GBM 1513.5] /// ... His relatives and kinsmen, not seeing him, began to search everywhere, but could not find [him]. [GBM 1513.6] /// ... [He was] discovered. Then his parents were informed: 'My [son] entered <s>Vāsavadattā</s>'s house...' [GBM 1513.7] /// ... Then a great commotion arose in <s>Mathurā</s>. The king heard [of it]. The king said, 'Go, sirs, [GBM 1513.8] /// ...' Then <s>Vāsavadattā</s>, [while] being restrained by her loved ones, being lamented by neutral people,
